scope: All12 actual v06 candidate PNG originals were opened individually: male/female full front, face front, both profiles, three-quarter and rear head. No engine was launched by this reviewer. Motion and other body profiles require the separate final native cohort. The two generated paint references were also inspected; they are not game screenshots.
observed_improvements: Continuous tapered brows replace the fragmented overlapping strokes.
Narrower relaxed almond openings cover more iris; lateral orbital tissue and sewn hood reduce the earlier external white wedge. A small profile aperture remains.
M lower jaw/chin and F shorter oval jaw have rounded transitions; the two silhouettes differ.
M short swept part and F longer layered bob keep eyes/central cheeks open and cover rear head; floating crown arc and earlier rear gap are absent.
Bounded original paint colour gives nose/lip tissue variation with less pore-to-vertex patching.
remaining_art_limits: Nose/alar and cheek planes still look angular at three-quarter/profile; this is not a finished realistic face sculpture.
Gaze remains neutral and procedural; no blink, facial expression or speech blendshapes were authored.
Hair is a rigid grouped groom with repeated flow/ribbing and small crown/edge gaps, not fine individual strands or secondary hair simulation.
Lower head/upper neck still has simplified planar transitions in profile.
Current body/clothing/hands remain the previous authored prototype; this task preserves their geometry and motion contracts rather than completing all human realism.
excluded_claims: No completed beauty/attractiveness rating or user acceptance.
No generated reference image is presented as a rendered game result.
No naturalness-in-motion completion from static screenshots.
production_asset_equivalence: Standard4 candidate GLBs are byte-identical to production4; see production_body_preservation.json.
